title: OPEC Adds Fuel To The Fire
section_path: OPEC Adds Fuel To The Fire
section_path_text: OPEC Adds Fuel To The Fire
summary:
Another production increase suggests a change in strategy
About one month ago, we wrote our tanker opinion about the surprise decision of OPEC+ to increase production well above the monthly increase previously indicated (" OPEC Springs A Surprise " ). On April 3, the eight OPEC+ countries that committed to voluntary production adjustments in 2023, decided to bring back 411,000 b/d in May, three times the April 2025 increase of 137,000 b/d. Most analysts expected this to be a one-off production boost.
